title: VTC — Vetting PCS Challenge — payload
description: An applicant asks the community for the single-use challenge its hidden-vetting proof must be bound to. The community issues one per applicant and spends it when the proof is counted, so a proof cannot be submitted twice.

criterionId.description: OPTIONAL. The `id` of the admission criterion the coming submission answers. A community running one hidden-vetting criterion needs no hint; one running several may use it to refuse early rather than at submit.

Response.title: VTC Vetting PCS Challenge — response payload
Response.description: The challenge, and when it stops being accepted.

challenge.description: Lowercase hex, 16 bytes. Compared for equality and never parsed; the applicant binds it into the proof's context.

expiresAt.description: After this instant the challenge is refused. A submission that misses it asks for another.
